en: "Oh! Are you the famous Momotaro-san?"{KP}"Then would you hear one request of mine?"{KN}

jp:
「……やはり　そうじゃのォ！
　初めて　会った方に
　わしも　失礼なことを　したわい！」
en: "......I thought as much! It was rude of me to ask someone I've only just met!"

"Oh, really? You'll hear me out!"{KP}"You see, this village, so dark now, was once lit by a sacred fire called the {bb}Year's End Fire{ww},"{KP}"which burns on and on without any firewood!"{KP}"But someone poured water on the fire and put it out!"{KP}"To get the {bb}Year's End Fire{ww} again,"{KP}"one must play the game {bb}Wobbly Candle!{ww} at the {bb}shrine{ww} to the north, but"{KP}"everyone in the village is old, you see, and we can't clear games like we used to!"{KP}"So, Momotaro-san! Would you play that game in our place?"{KN}

jp:
「おお　ありがたい！
　では　よろしく　頼みますぞ！」
en: "Oh, how kind! Then I'm counting on you!"

jp:
「……やはり　そうじゃのう
　はじめて　あった方に　
　わしも　失礼なことを　したわい」
en: "......I thought as much. It was rude of me to ask someone I've only just met."

jp:
「桃太郎さん！
　よろしく　頼みましたぞ！」

「おお　桃太郎さん！
　{bb}大としの火{ww}を　ありがとう！」
　{KP}
「お礼に　{bb}方言カード{ww}を
　さしあげましょう！」
en: "Oh, Momotaro-san! Thank you for the {bb}Year's End Fire{ww}!"{KP}"As thanks, let me give you a {bb}Dialect Card{ww}!"

jp:
「桃太郎さんの　おかげで！
　みな　喜んで　おります！」
en: "Thanks to you, Momotaro-san, everyone is overjoyed!"
